function.name: process
function.description: Manage background processes started with terminal(background=true). Actions: 'list' (show all), 'poll' (check status + new output), 'log' (full output with pagination), 'wait' (block until done or timeout), 'kill' (terminate), 'write' (send raw stdin data without newline), 'submit' (send data + Enter, for answering prompts), 'close' (close stdin/send EOF).

action.description: Action to perform on background processes

session_id.description: Process session ID (from terminal background output). Required for all actions except 'list'.

data.description: Text to send to process stdin (for 'write' and 'submit' actions)

timeout.description: Max seconds to block for 'wait' action. Returns partial output on timeout.

offset.description: Line offset for 'log' action (default: last 200 lines)

limit.description: Max lines to return for 'log' action

function.name: send_message
function.description:
Send a message to a connected messaging platform, or list available targets.

IMPORTANT: When the user asks to send to a specific channel or person (not just a bare platform name), call send_message(action='list') FIRST to see available targets, then send to the correct one.

action.description: Action to perform. 'send' (default) sends a message. 'list' returns all available channels/contacts across connected platforms.

target.description: Delivery target. Format: 'platform' (uses home channel), 'platform:#channel-name', 'platform:chat_id', or 'platform:chat_id:thread_id' for Telegram topics and Discord threads. message.description: The message text to send. To send an image or file, include MEDIA:<local_path> (e.g. 'MEDIA:/tmp/hermes/cache/img_xxx.jpg') in the message — the platform will deliver it as a native media attachment.

function.name: skill_manage
function.description:
Manage skills (create, update, delete). Skills are your procedural memory — reusable approaches for recurring task types. New skills go to ~/.hermes/skills/; existing skills can be modified wherever they live.

Actions: create (full SKILL.md + optional category), patch (old_string/new_string — preferred for fixes), edit (full SKILL.md rewrite — major overhauls only), delete, write_file, remove_file.

On delete, pass `absorbed_into=<umbrella>` when you're merging this skill's content into another one, or `absorbed_into=""` when you're pruning it with no forwarding target. This lets the curator tell consolidation from pruning without guessing, so downstream consumers (cron jobs that reference the old skill name, etc.) get updated correctly. The target you name in `absorbed_into` must already exist — create/patch the umbrella first, then delete.

Create when: complex task succeeded (5+ calls), errors overcome, user-corrected approach worked, non-trivial workflow discovered, or user asks you to remember a procedure.
Update when: instructions stale/wrong, OS-specific failures, missing steps or pitfalls found during use. If you used a skill and hit issues not covered by it, patch it immediately.

After difficult/iterative tasks, offer to save as a skill. Skip for simple one-offs. Confirm with user before creating/deleting.

Good skills: trigger conditions, numbered steps with exact commands, pitfalls section, verification steps. Use skill_view() to see format examples.

Pinned skills are off-limits — all write actions refuse with a message pointing the user to `hermes curator unpin <name>`. Don't try to route around this by renaming or recreating.

name.description: Skill name (lowercase, hyphens/underscores, max 64 chars). Must match an existing skill for patch/edit/delete/write_file/remove_file.

content.description: Full SKILL.md content (YAML frontmatter + markdown body). Required for 'create' and 'edit'. For 'edit', read the skill first with skill_view() and provide the complete updated text.

old_string.description: Text to find in the file (required for 'patch'). Must be unique unless replace_all=true. Include enough surrounding context to ensure uniqueness.

new_string.description: Replacement text (required for 'patch'). Can be empty string to delete the matched text.

replace_all.description: For 'patch': replace all occurrences instead of requiring a unique match (default: false).

category.description: Optional category/domain for organizing the skill (e.g., 'devops', 'data-science', 'mlops'). Creates a subdirectory grouping. Only used with 'create'.

file_path.description: Path to a supporting file within the skill directory. For 'write_file'/'remove_file': required, must be under references/, templates/, scripts/, or assets/. For 'patch': optional, defaults to SKILL.md if omitted.

file_content.description: Content for the file. Required for 'write_file'.

absorbed_into.description: For 'delete' only — declares intent so the curator can tell consolidation from pruning without guessing. Pass the umbrella skill name when this skill's content was merged into another (the target must already exist). Pass an empty string when the skill is truly stale and being pruned with no forwarding target. Omitting the arg on delete is supported for backward compatibility but downstream tooling (e.g. cron-job skill reference rewriting) will have to guess at intent.

function.name: terminal
function.description:
Execute shell commands on a Linux environment. Filesystem usually persists between calls.

Do NOT use cat/head/tail to read files — use read_file instead.
Do NOT use grep/rg/find to search — use search_files instead.
Do NOT use ls to list directories — use search_files(target='files') instead.
Do NOT use sed/awk to edit files — use patch instead.
Do NOT use echo/cat heredoc to create files — use write_file instead.
Reserve terminal for: builds, installs, git, processes, scripts, network, package managers, and anything that needs a shell.

Foreground (default): Commands return INSTANTLY when done, even if the timeout is high. Set timeout=300 for long builds/scripts — you'll still get the result in seconds if it's fast. Prefer foreground for short commands.
Background: Set background=true to get a session_id. Two patterns:
  (1) Long-lived processes that never exit (servers, watchers).
  (2) Long-running tasks with notify_on_complete=true — you can keep working on other things and the system auto-notifies you when the task finishes. Great for test suites, builds, deployments, or anything that takes more than a minute.

{"success": true, "name": "sop-content-transform", "file": "scripts/content_transform.py", "content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
content_transform.py: 原子内容变换 skill 脚本。

扫描 raw/web-links/ 中含 frontmatter action 的文件，
执行变换，写出到 raw/web-transformed/，git push 触发 wiki-build。
"""

import argparse
import json
import os
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path


def log(msg):
    print(f"[content-transform] {msg}", flush=True)


def send_tg(text: str):
    token = os.environ.get("YOUTUBE_WIKI_TG_TOKEN", "")
    chat_id = os.environ.get("YOUTUBE_WIKI_TG_CHAT_ID", "")
    if not token or not chat_id:
        return
    try:
        subprocess.run([
            "curl", "-s", "-X", "POST",
            f"https://api.telegram.org/bot{token}/sendMessage",
            "-d", f"chat_id={chat_id}",
            "-d", "disable_web_page_preview=true",
            "--data-urlencode", f"text={text}",
            "--max-time", "10",
        ], capture_output=True)
    except Exception:
        pass


PROMPTS = {
    "translate": (
        "请将以下文章完整翻译成中文，保留 Markdown 格式。标题也翻译。"
        "只输出翻译内容，不要解释。\n\n{content}"
    ),
    "summarize": (
        "请对以下文章进行深度总结，用中文输出。格式：\n"
        "## 核心观点\n## 关键细节\n## 结论\n\n"
        "只输出总结。\n\n{content}"
    ),
    "extract_key_points": (
        "请从以下文章提炼核心论点，中文输出。"
        "每个论点加粗，下方附1-2句支撑说明。只输出结果。\n\n{content}"
    ),
    "translate_and_extract": (
        "请对以下文章执行两步操作：\n"
        "1. 完整翻译成中文（保留 Markdown 格式）\n"
        "2. 在翻译后追加「## 核心论点」章节，提炼3-5个关键论点\n\n"
        "只输出处理后的内容。\n\n{content}"
    ),
}


def call_gemini(prompt: str) -> str:
    api_key = os.environ.get("GOOGLE_CLOUD_API_KEY", "")
    if not api_key:
        raise RuntimeError("GOOGLE_CLOUD_API_KEY not set")
    model = os.environ.get("WIKI_GEMINI_MODEL", "gemini-2.0-flash-lite")
    payload = json.dumps({
        "contents": [{"role": "user", "parts": [{"text": prompt}]}],
        "generationConfig": {"temperature": 0.1, "maxOutputTokens": 8000},
    }).encode()
    url = (f"https://aiplatform.googleapis.com/v1/publishers/google/models"
           f"/{model}:generateContent?key={api_key}")
    req = urllib.request.Request(
        url, data=payload, headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"}
    )
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=120) as resp:
        data = json.loads(resp.read())
    return data["candidates"][0]["content"]["parts"][0]["text"]


def parse_frontmatter(text: str) -> tuple[dict, str]:
    """解析 YAML frontmatter，返回 (meta_dict, body)"""
    if not text.startswith("---"):
        return {}, text
    parts = text.split("---", 2)
    if len(parts) < 3:
        return {}, text
    try:
        import yaml
        meta = yaml.safe_load(parts[1]) or {}
        body = parts[2].lstrip("\n")
        return meta, body
    except Exception:
        return {}, text


def transform_file(src: Path, out_dir: Path) -> bool:
    """读取文件，执行 frontmatter 中指定的 action，写出到 out_dir。"""
    text = src.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    meta, body = parse_frontmatter(text)

    action = meta.get("action", "").strip()
    if not action:
        # 无 action = 内容已是目标语言，直接 pass-through 到 web-transformed
        # 避免 pipeline 在此卡死，后续 wiki-build 正常接管
        log(f"  {src.name}: 无 action，pass-through 到 web-transformed")
        out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        (out_dir / src.name).write_text(src.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), encoding="utf-8")
        return True

    log(f"  {src.name}: action={action}")

    prompt_template = PROMPTS.get(action)
    if not prompt_template:
        log(f"  未知 action: {action}，原样输出")
        result = body
    else:
        content = body[:12000] + "\n\n...[截断]" if len(body) > 12000 else body
        try:
            result = call_gemini(prompt_template.format(content=content))
            log(f"  变换完成，输出 {len(result)} 字符")
        except Exception as e:
            log(f"  Gemini 失败: {e}，使用原文")
            result = body

    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    out_file = out_dir / src.name
    out_file.write_text(result, encoding="utf-8")
    return True


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--wiki-path", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--run-id", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--git-push", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    wiki_path = Path(args.wiki_path).expanduser()
    src_dir = wiki_path / "raw" / "web-links"
    out_dir = wiki_path / "raw" / "web-transformed"

    # git sync
    subprocess.run(["git", "fetch", "origin", "main"],
                   cwd=wiki_path, capture_output=True)
    subprocess.run(["git", "reset", "--hard", "origin/main"],
                   cwd=wiki_path, capture_output=True)

    if not src_dir.exists():
        log("raw/web-links/ 不存在，退出")
        sys.exit(0)

    files = [f for f in src_dir.glob("*.md") if f.name != ".gitkeep"]
    if not files:
        log("no files to transform")
        sys.exit(0)

    send_tg(f"🔄 [CONTENT-TRANSFORM] 开始变换\n   {len(files)} 个文件待处理")

    transformed = []
    for f in files:
        text = f.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        meta, _ = parse_frontmatter(text)
        if not meta.get("action"):
            continue
        ok = transform_file(f, out_dir)
        if ok:
            transformed.append(f)

    if not transformed:
        log("no files with action frontmatter")
        sys.exit(0)

    log(f"transform done: {len(transformed)} files")

    # ── 验证：原文保留 + 翻译质量检查（Evaluator 的轻量实现）──
    issues = []
    for f in transformed:
        # 1. 原文是否还在
        if not f.exists():
            issues.append(f"❌ 原文丢失: {f.name}")
        # 2. 翻译文件是否生成
        out_file = out_dir / f.name
        if not out_file.exists():
            issues.append(f"❌ 翻译未生成: {f.name}")
        else:
            # 3. 翻译内容是否为中文（简单检测）
            translated_text = out_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
            chinese_chars = len(re.findall(r'[一-鿿]', translated_text))
            total_chars = len(translated_text.replace(" ", "").replace("\n", ""))
            chinese_ratio = chinese_chars / max(total_chars, 1)
            if chinese_ratio < 0.1:
                issues.append(f"⚠️ 翻译中文比例过低({chinese_ratio:.0%}): {f.name}")
    if issues:
        alert = "🚨 [CONTENT-TRANSFORM] 验证发现问题\n" + "\n".join(issues)
        log(alert)
        send_tg(alert)
    else:
        log("✅ 验证通过：原文保留，翻译质量正常")

    if args.git_push:
        try:
            # 原文保留在 raw/web-links/，只清除 action frontmatter 标记为已处理
            for f in transformed:
                text = f.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
                meta, body = parse_frontmatter(text)
                if meta.get("action"):
                    # 移除 action 字段，保留其他 frontmatter，原文 body 完整保留
                    meta.pop("action", None)
                    if meta:
                        import yaml as _yaml
                        new_front = "---\n" + _yaml.dump(meta, allow_unicode=True) + "---\n\n"
                    else:
                        new_front = ""
                    f.write_text(new_front + body, encoding="utf-8")

            # 写 pipeline_type 进 pipeline-context.json，供 tg-notify 格式选择
            ctx_file = wiki_path / "raw" / "pipeline-context.json"
            try:
                ctx = json.loads(ctx_file.read_text()) if ctx_file.exists() else {}
            except Exception:
                ctx = {}
            ctx["pipeline_type"] = "web-wiki"
            ctx_file.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            ctx_file.write_text(json.dumps(ctx, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))

            subprocess.run(["git", "add", str(out_dir), str(src_dir), str(ctx_file)],
                           cwd=wiki_path, check=True, capture_output=True)
            subprocess.run(["git", "add", "-A"],
                           cwd=wiki_path, check=True, capture_output=True)
            subprocess.run([
                "git", "commit", "-m",
                f"chore: content-transform done [{args.run_id}] "
                f"[{len(transformed)} files]"
            ], cwd=wiki_path, check=True, capture_output=True)
            subprocess.run(["git", "push", "origin", "main"],
                           cwd=wiki_path, check=True, capture_output=True)
            log("git push ✅")
            send_tg(
                f"✅ [CONTENT-TRANSFORM] 变换完成\n"
                f"   {len(transformed)} 个文件 → raw/web-transformed/\n"
                f"   Wiki 构建已触发..."
            )
        except subprocess.CalledProcessError as e:
            log(f"git push 失败: {e}")
            sys.exit(1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
